title: Support Specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿ This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT

Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.

Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;
  • Elaborar e conduzir refinamentos técnicos de demandas trazidas pelo time de produtos;
  • Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js + NestJS;
  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;
  • Experiência com Design de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com Testes Unitários (jUnit 5) e Testes Contrato (Pact);
  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;
  • Experiência com em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.

Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco

  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

title: Senior Consultant, Training & Enablement
description:
Sobre a vaga

A dhauz, empresa do grupo Quantum Rise, é empresa de serviços e soluções usando dados e inteligência artificial para suportar processos de tomada de decisão de negócios. Somos uma equipe interdisciplinar de profissionais formados nas melhores universidades do país e do exterior, com ampla experiência no mercado e prontos para auxiliar a transformação analítica de grandes marcas. Engenharia de dados, tecnologia, processos e pessoas combinados da melhor maneira para cada necessidade do seu projeto.

E aí, curtiu? #VemSerUmHauzer

Quem estamos procurando?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Sênior, Learning & Enablement para integrar nosso time no Brasil. Esta posição terá foco no desenho, desenvolvimento e administração de produtos de treinamento em IA que apoiem a alfabetização em inteligência artificial, o desenvolvimento de capacidades e a adoção da IA por diferentes públicos.

Trata-se de uma função voltada a produto de aprendizagem, responsável por construir experiências de aprendizado em IA escaláveis e de alta qualidade. No momento, a posição não é voltada ao atendimento direto a clientes e terá como foco o desenho curricular, desenvolvimento de conteúdo, operação de programas e melhoria contínua das ofertas de enablement em IA.

Responsabilidades :

Design e Desenvolvimento de Produtos de Aprendizagem em IA

  • Desenhar programas completos de treinamento em IA (ex.: workshops, self-paced modules, bootcamps, aprendizagem híbrida, certificações).
  • Desenvolver materiais instrucionais como apresentações, guias para facilitadores, exercícios, avaliações, toolkits e estudos de caso.
  • Traduzir temas de IA (ex.: IA generativa, automação, governança de IA, engenharia de prompts, fundamentos de dados) em experiências de aprendizagem claras e práticas.
  • Aplicar princípios de aprendizagem de adultos e metodologias modernas de design instrucional.
  • Desenvolver atividades práticas que incentivem o uso aplicado de IA.

Produção de Conteúdo e Qualidade

  • Criar ativos de aprendizagem escaláveis e reutilizáveis.
  • Garantir clareza, precisão e consistência em todos os materiais de treinamento em IA.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com especialistas técnicos em IA para validar o conteúdo.
  • Refinar continuamente o currículo com base em feedback, análises e evolução do cenário de IA.

Administração e Operação de Programas

  • Gerenciar programas de treinamento por meio de LMS ou outras plataformas de aprendizagem.
  • Coordenar upload de conteúdos, avaliações, certificações e trilhas de aprendizagem.
  • Acompanhar métricas de participação, engajamento e aprendizagem.
  • Manter documentação e controle de versão dos ativos educacionais.

Qualificações

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa.
  • 6 a 10+ anos de experiência em:
  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento
  • Design Instrucional
  • Iniciativas de enablement ou transformação digital
  • Educação ou treinamento em tecnologia
  • Experiência no desenho e desenvolvimento de programas de aprendizagem profissional.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral, com atenção aos detalhes.

Diferenciais

  • Mestrado em Instructional Design, Learning Science, Adult Learning
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de produtos de aprendizagem digitais ou híbridos.
  • Experiência com administração de LMS.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA (ex.: LLMs, copilots, plataformas de automação).
  • Certificações em design instrucional ou aprendizagem de adultos.
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e orientados ao crescimento.

Tipo de contratação:

✅ Regime CLT ou PJ

✅100% Remoto

Benefícios como CLT:

  • Cartão de benefícios flexíveis Flash (alimentação/refeição);

description:
Sobre a vaga

A dhauz, empresa do grupo Quantum Rise, é empresa de serviços e soluções usando dados e inteligência artificial para suportar processos de tomada de decisão de negócios. Somos uma equipe interdisciplinar de profissionais formados nas melhores universidades do país e do exterior, com ampla experiência no mercado e prontos para auxiliar a transformação analítica de grandes marcas. Engenharia de dados, tecnologia, processos e pessoas combinados da melhor maneira para cada necessidade do seu projeto.

E aí, curtiu? #VemSerUmHauzer

Quem estamos procurando?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) Sênior, Learning & Enablement para integrar nosso time no Brasil. Esta posição terá foco no desenho, desenvolvimento e administração de produtos de treinamento em IA que apoiem a alfabetização em inteligência artificial, o desenvolvimento de capacidades e a adoção da IA por diferentes públicos.

Trata-se de uma função voltada a produto de aprendizagem, responsável por construir experiências de aprendizado em IA escaláveis e de alta qualidade. No momento, a posição não é voltada ao atendimento direto a clientes e terá como foco o desenho curricular, desenvolvimento de conteúdo, operação de programas e melhoria contínua das ofertas de enablement em IA.

Responsabilidades :

Design e Desenvolvimento de Produtos de Aprendizagem em IA

  • Desenhar programas completos de treinamento em IA (ex.: workshops, self-paced modules, bootcamps, aprendizagem híbrida, certificações).
  • Desenvolver materiais instrucionais como apresentações, guias para facilitadores, exercícios, avaliações, toolkits e estudos de caso.
  • Traduzir temas de IA (ex.: IA generativa, automação, governança de IA, engenharia de prompts, fundamentos de dados) em experiências de aprendizagem claras e práticas.
  • Aplicar princípios de aprendizagem de adultos e metodologias modernas de design instrucional.
  • Desenvolver atividades práticas que incentivem o uso aplicado de IA.

Produção de Conteúdo e Qualidade

  • Criar ativos de aprendizagem escaláveis e reutilizáveis.
  • Garantir clareza, precisão e consistência em todos os materiais de treinamento em IA.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com especialistas técnicos em IA para validar o conteúdo.
  • Refinar continuamente o currículo com base em feedback, análises e evolução do cenário de IA.

Administração e Operação de Programas

  • Gerenciar programas de treinamento por meio de LMS ou outras plataformas de aprendizagem.
  • Coordenar upload de conteúdos, avaliações, certificações e trilhas de aprendizagem.
  • Acompanhar métricas de participação, engajamento e aprendizagem.
  • Manter documentação e controle de versão dos ativos educacionais.

Qualificações

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa.
  • 6 a 10+ anos de experiência em:
  • Treinamento e Desenvolvimento
  • Design Instrucional
  • Iniciativas de enablement ou transformação digital
  • Educação ou treinamento em tecnologia
  • Experiência no desenho e desenvolvimento de programas de aprendizagem profissional.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral, com atenção aos detalhes.

Diferenciais

  • Mestrado em Instructional Design, Learning Science, Adult Learning
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de produtos de aprendizagem digitais ou híbridos.
  • Experiência com administração de LMS.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA (ex.: LLMs, copilots, plataformas de automação).
  • Certificações em design instrucional ou aprendizagem de adultos.
  • Experiência em ambientes dinâmicos e orientados ao crescimento.

Tipo de contratação:

✅ Regime CLT ou PJ

✅100% Remoto

Benefícios como CLT:

  • Cartão de benefícios flexíveis Flash (alimentação/refeição);

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay

Local de trabalho: Remoto

Modelo de trabalho: CLT

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver micro serviços independentes que resolvem problemas de domínio específico
  • Responsável por todo ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de código, indo do planejamento junto com o time de produto (pré código) até o deploy em produção e acompanhamento dos seus impactos (pós código).
  • Resolver problemas e contribuir com os desafios do time de tecnologia e de produto, compartilhando ideias, soluções, códigos, arquiteturas, etc.
  • Aprimorar a experiência do desenvolvimento de software na Gringo, considerando ferramentas, cobertura de testes, estrutura de códigos, etc.
  • Participar ativamente de discussões e decisões voltadas para design de software. Tomando a frente e ajudando a criar documentação.
  • Criar soluções escaláveis, sustentáveis e focadas no usuário. Nós usamos tecnologias como Node.js , Python, React Native, Flutter, PostgreSQL. Você não precisa conhece-las, mas estar aberto a aprendê-las.
  • Ajudar a organizar a arquitetura de software para orquestrar harmonicamente nossa arquitetura de serviços.

Requisitos e qualificações

É imprescindível que você tenha:

  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação
  • Experiência com APIs
  • Raciocínio logico

Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

  • Demonstrar experiência desenvolvendo aplicações mobile escaláveis e focadas na cliente.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como GCP, AWS, Azure, etc
  • Entende como CI/CD funciona.
  • Tiver conhecimento em containers e orquestração como Kubernetes, por exemplo.
  • Experiência de desenvolvimento mobile

Informações adicionais

Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + UX/UI + AI-Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley–based product company building a next‑generation B2B single-page application used daily by enterprise customers. We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who is both a hands-on React expert and a strong UX/UI thinker, someone who can own the user experience end‑to‑end, from concept to polished production implementation.

This is a role for a self-directed, highly motivated engineer who can hit the ground running, collaborate closely with product/design, and loves leveraging the latest AI tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and iteration.

What You Will Do

  • Architect, build, and deliver modern, high-performance React applications for a complex B2B SaaS product.
  • Translate product concepts and user workflows into frictionless UX flows, wireframes, and pixel-perfect UI components.
  • Collaborate with Product, and Backend teams to shape features from idea to release.
  • Implement real-time features using SignalR and other websocket technologies.
  • Work with AI agents and tools daily for coding, refactoring, UI generation, documentation, and test creation.
  • Write automated tests with Playwright and other testing frameworks.
  • Drive UI performance, accessibility, and maintainability best practices.
  • Think holistically: not just “take tasks,” but help shape the product, the experience, and the architecture.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Full US Pacific Time availability (not partial overlap).
  • Fluent verbal and written English; comfortable with daily video-based collaboration .
  • 5+ years of hands-on React experience (hooks, context, state management, component architecture).
  • Strong UX/UI sensibility—capable of producing or improving wireframes, interaction flows, and visual details.
  • Experience working directly from Figma or similar UI tools.
  • Experience with real-time applications (SignalR preferred but not required).
  • Comfort with Node.js for lightweight tooling or UI-supporting backends.
  • Familiarity with Electron , WebSockets , and HTML5 .
  • Regular, disciplined use of AI tools for development.
  • Strong communication, accountability, and a bias toward problem-solving.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products and complex user workflows.
  • Understanding of frontend architecture patterns at scale.
  • Background in design systems or component libraries.
  • Experience in performance tuning for real-time or heavy-data UIs.

Who You Are

  • A team player with strong ownership and bias for action.
  • Someone who enjoys “figuring things out” rather than waiting for instructions.
  • A builder who can think outside the box , challenge assumptions, and propose better solutions.
  • A believer in AI-accelerated engineering and modern best practices.
  • A product-mindset engineer who cares deeply about user experience—from pixels to workflows.

Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a tight‑knit, fast-moving team where your work directly shapes the product experience. You’ll have the autonomy to influence UI/UX direction, introduce best practices, and work with a modern AI-enabled workflow that rewards creativity and initiative.

If you are a senior frontend engineer who crafts beautiful interfaces, moves fast, and wants to push the edge of what AI-accelerated development can do , we’d love to talk.

title: Meitu Campus Ambassador (Design Track)
description:
Remote Work, Part-time, Internship

We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for aesthetics who can catch the hottest visual styles on campus and help our products look and feel right for local users.

What You’ll Do:

● Capture Visual Trends: Continuously analyze the aesthetic preferences and popular styles among local students to guide product design.

● Localize Visuals: Help adjust marketing materials visually (like layout and cultural fit) and create visuals that align with local aesthetics.

● Be a design critic: Review our products (and competitors') from a user’s perspective identify visual or experience flaws, and give practical feedback.

We Hope You Are:

● Have a keen eye: naturally notice design, imagery, and visual trends in everyday life and social media; are interested in youth culture and what’s trending locally.

● Think like a visual detective: not just see if something looks good—but ask why it’s designed in that way and how it could be better.

● Care about user experience: pay attention to how visuals affect usability and enjoy comparing product designs critically.

Bonus Points If You Have:

● Extensive knowledge of local visual product usage habits gained from living in regions like North America, Latam America, or East/Southeast Asia.

● A background in design, art, visual communication, or digital media arts.

● Have hands-on experience in graphic design, UI/UX, video editing, or photography.

● Are part of design clubs, competitions, or create visual content yourself.

What You’ll Get:

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design

Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)

About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.

Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Electrical BIM Lead
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U.S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.


We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:


Eracore is growing in Brazil , and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U.S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.


Why You’ll Enjoy Working at Eracore

  • Competitive hourly pay
  • Fully remote work
  • Learning platforms for professional growth
  • Supportive leadership and mentorship


Your Role

  • Lead and support the development of Electrical BIM models
  • Review models, perform clash detection, and ensure quality standards
  • Support and mentor BIM team members
  • Coordinate with other BIM trades
  • Prepare BIM documents such as reports, schedules, execution plans and shop drawings
  • Work daily with Revit and Navisworks and Bluebeam
  • Improve workflows and modeling processes when needed
  • Communicate clearly with client BIM teams throughout the project


What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Electrical BIM
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Advanced Revit skills with an electrical focus
  • Experience using Navisworks for coordination and clash detection
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, and Bluebeam
  • Team-oriented mindset with experience in managing the team
  • 2+ successfully finished projects
  • Reliable, organized, and deadline-focused

Pay Rate LinkedIn style:

  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.

title: Digital Designer (UX/UI)
description:
Location: Remote

Team: International (multi-country collaboration)

Company Description

Bucksense, Inc. is a digital marketing technology company that connects brands and publishers through transparent, performance-driven solutions. We combine advanced technology with hands-on expertise to deliver measurable results across programmatic, social and display advertising, content marketing, SEO, and SEM. Our unified platform helps brands maintain control over their data and outcomes, while our DirectoPub solution enables publishers to optimize revenue efficiently.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Digital Designer (UX/UI) to join our team and help create high-quality, user-centered digital experiences. This role is ideal for someone with a strong visual design foundation, excellent attention to detail, and a solid understanding of UX/UI principles. You will collaborate closely with developers and cross-functional teams in an international, remote environment.

Fluency in English is mandatory, and strong proficiency in Figma is essential.

Key Requirements

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma
  • Strong UX/UI principles and user-centered design approach
  • Excellent attention to detail and typography
  • Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Canva
  • Basic knowledge of HTML & CSS
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, international team

Experience

  • Designing creative assets for web, display, and social
  • UI design for responsive web and mobile
  • Collaboration with developers and cross-functional teams
  • Working with international stakeholders and distributed teams

Nice to Have

  • Adobe XD, Premiere Pro, After Effects
  • Experience with WordPress or other CMS
  • Proactive, trend-aware mindset
  • Strong problem-solving skills and curiosity for new technologies

Please apply with:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio

title: Especialista de Middleware (Produção)
description:
Atividades:

  • Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;
  • Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;
  • Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;
  • Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);
  • Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;
  • Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;
  • Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;
  • Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;
  • Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;
  • Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;
  • Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;
  • Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.

The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Tech Lead Node.JS
description:
Responsabilidades


Liderança Técnica: Orientar a equipe de desenvolvimento, definir padrões e melhores práticas, garantindo a qualidade do código e a implementação de soluções eficientes.

Arquitetura e Design: Participar do design e da arquitetura de sistemas, definindo a estrutura do código, as tecnologias a serem utilizadas e a organização do projeto.

Facilitação do Scrum: Facilitar as cerimônias Scrum (planning, daily, review e retrospectiva), assegurar o cumprimento do processo, remover impedimentos e promover a colaboração e a comunicação do time.

Mentoria e Treinamento: Mentorar e apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos membros da equipe, compartilhando conhecimento e incentivando o aprendizado contínuo.

Gerenciamento de Riscos: Identificar e analisar riscos técnicos do projeto, propor planos de mitigação e garantir a segurança e a estabilidade do sistema.


Requisitos Técnicos


Linguagens de Programação: Domínio profundo de linguagens relevantes para o projeto, com foco em Node.js.

Arquitetura de Software: Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura, frameworks e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de sistemas.

Banco de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL, incluindo design, modelagem e otimização de queries.

Versionamento de Código: Domínio de ferramentas como Git, incluindo uso de branches, merges, pull requests e workflows.


Formação e Experiência

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica e desenvolvimento de software.

Conhecimento de boas práticas de desenvolvimento (SOLID, Clean Code).

Desejável certificações em áreas como gerenciamento de projetos, frameworks de desenvolvimento ou linguagens de programação.

Inglês técnico para leitura e escrita.

title: Desenvolvedor de Mobile
description:
VAGA — DESENVOLVEDOR MOBILE (PLENO / SÊNIOR)

Empresa: Atman

FAIXA SALARIAL

R$ 4.500 a R$ 9.000 (CLT)

Enquadramento conforme avaliação técnica.

SOBRE A VAGA

Vaga para desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile voltados a produtos digitais, com consumo de APIs complexas, dados em tempo real, integração com hardware e dispositivos, uso de mapas e geolocalização e atuação em aplicações operacionais e críticas.

Os aplicativos suportam configuração de dispositivos, comunicação contínua com backend e operação em ambientes que exigem estabilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade em produção.

RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicativos mobile Android e iOS
  • Implementação de aplicações em React Native
  • Integração com APIs REST e comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware e dispositivos
  • Implementação de funcionalidades com mapas e geolocalização
  • Atuação em apps operacionais e críticos
  • Garantia de estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade
  • Gerenciamento de estado, ciclo de vida e comunicação assíncrona
  • Integração com times de backend, frontend web, hardware e produto

STACK E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS (OBRIGATÓRIOS)

  • React Native
  • TypeScript e JavaScript
  • Consumo de APIs REST
  • Comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware / dispositivos
  • Uso de mapas e geolocalização
  • Conceitos de performance mobile
  • Versionamento com Git

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Espanhol ou Italiano a nível de conversação serão considerados um grande diferencial.
  • Experiência com Android nativo (Kotlin)
  • Experiência com apps publicados em loja
  • Vivência com aplicações operacionais ou críticas
  • Integração com dispositivos físicos

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com desenvolvimento mobile
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado
  • Graduação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas

PERFIL TÉCNICO ESPERADO

  • Perfil analítico
  • Capacidade técnica elevada
  • Facilidade para resolver problemas complexos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.

  • Capacidade de ir além da execução técnica, contribuindo com ideias e melhorias
  • Senso de responsabilidade e autonomia no dia a dia


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes serverless em produção
  • Vivência em projetos com forte volume de integrações entre sistemas

title: Travel Coordinator
description:
Our Company :A fast-growing start-up headquartered in San Francisco, CA, USA in the heart of Silicon Valley. We recruit worldwide as our customer base is global. Reliable ground transportation provider, any type of vehicle globally.

Vision: Reliable ground transportation services globally with all types of vehicles.

Mission: Empower high-quality local fleets

Corporate Culture:

  • Team first partner-centric
  • Team collaboration,
  • Never \"not my job\", end-to-end ownership,
  • Continuous learning and improvement,
  • Hard-working and pragmatic,
  • Don’t be a middleman,
  • Result-driven

Responsibilities:

  • Constant negotiation with new drivers and fleet companies and maintaining existing supplier for Ground Transport services in geo-assigned
  • Negotiation of rates for ground transportation services
  • Ensure availability and competitive prices for ground transportation services.
  • Participate in market and competition researchCoordinate and resolve issues from supplier side notification, cancelations, and operational problems among others
  • Analyze market trends for pricingProblem-solvingMake calls to the appropriate driver to assign a ride. Performing Last Minute assignment.
  • Confirm the ride was done and apply the change in the system or ask the driver to do it.
  • Contact Drivers for rates negotiation and onboardingAssisting with internal communications with CS, QA, and other departments
  • Customer Service support.

Experience:

3 years experience working in the Tourism & services sector, tourism product management.

3 years experience working in travel agencies, hotels or any tourism (required)

Knowledge of the for-hire vehicle industry.

Operational skillsStrategy implementation experience (required)Impeccable problem-solving skills.

Excellent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the Opportunity:

Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR. This person will be responsible for generating qualified leads and supporting the sales team with prospecting across different business lines, including AI, cloud, staffing, and internal products.

You'll work with modern tools and automations, including AI-powered content creation to assist in outreach. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow and have a direct impact on pipeline development.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead prospecting in the US market focused on setting qualified meetings.
  • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
  • Make cold calls when necessary.
  • Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
  • Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
  • Partner closely with Account Executives.

Requirements

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
  • Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.
  • Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).
  • Background in consulting or IT services companies.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: High-Stakes Poker Specialist
description:
EUROPROP® Trading is a performance-driven trading and digital asset firm operating at the intersection of quantitative strategy, risk management, and high-level decision science. We apply disciplined capital allocation principles across financial markets and strategic gaming environments where probabilistic thinking and risk optimization are critical.


Our team is composed of professionals with backgrounds in trading, analytics, game theory, and behavioral strategy. As we expand our strategic gaming division, we are seeking a highly skilled High-Stakes Poker Specialist to apply advanced decision-making, bankroll management, and risk-adjusted performance strategies in competitive high-stakes environments.


This is a unique opportunity to operate in a capital-backed, analytically structured environment where performance, discipline, and strategic edge are paramount.


Key Responsibilities
  • Compete in high-stakes online poker environments using advanced game theory optimal (GTO) and exploitative strategies.
  • Manage allocated bankroll with strict risk management and capital preservation principles.
  • Analyze hand histories, opponent tendencies, and statistical performance data to optimize win rate.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on solver outputs, probability modeling, and EV optimization.
  • Maintain detailed performance reporting, including ROI, variance metrics, and drawdown control.
  • Collaborate with internal analysts to enhance strategic frameworks and long-term profitability.


Requirements
  • Proven experience competing successfully in high-stakes online poker games.
  • Strong understanding of game theory, probability, variance, and bankroll management principles.
  • Demonstrated consistent profitability over a statistically meaningful sample size.
  • Experience using poker solvers and tracking software.
  • High emotional discipline and ability to perform under pressure.
  • Strong analytical mindset with structured decision-making skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fully remote environment.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual compensation R$360,000–R$420,000 plus performance-based incentives.
  • Fully remote position within Brazil.
  • Structured capital allocation with disciplined bankroll strategy.
  • Data-driven, professional performance environment.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with quantitative analysts and strategic experts.
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to profitability and risk-adjusted returns.

title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.

About the Role

As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.

Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.

What You’ll Gain

Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Stablecoin Payments Manager – Poker & Gaming
description:
EUROPROP® Trading is a performance-driven trading and digital asset firm operating at the intersection of quantitative finance, strategic gaming, and crypto-integrated treasury infrastructure. We specialize in disciplined capital allocation, stablecoin liquidity management, and cross-border digital payment systems designed for high-performance environments.


Our team combines expertise in crypto markets, treasury operations, gaming finance, and risk management to build secure, scalable payment frameworks. As we expand our poker and gaming payment infrastructure, we are seeking a highly skilled Stablecoin Payments Manager to lead and optimize stablecoin-based settlement and liquidity operations.


This is a high-impact role where operational precision, blockchain expertise, and capital efficiency directly influence performance outcomes.


Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee all stablecoin-based payment flows (USDT, USDC, and similar) across poker and gaming platforms.
  • Manage wallet infrastructure (hot/cold wallets) and ensure secure, efficient transaction processing.
  • Optimize liquidity allocation across platforms to minimize transfer costs and settlement delays.
  • Coordinate with exchanges, OTC desks, and payment providers for conversions and liquidity management.
  • Monitor blockchain transaction activity, fees, confirmation times, and operational risk exposure.
  • Implement AML/KYC and transaction monitoring controls for crypto payments.
  • Prepare treasury and payment performance reports, including liquidity ratios and cost efficiency metrics.


Requirements
  • Proven experience managing stablecoin or cryptocurrency payment operations.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain networks (e.g., TRC20, ERC20), wallet management, and exchange operations.
  • Experience handling high-volume crypto transactions in gaming, trading, or fintech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of liquidity management, volatility mitigation, and crypto-to-fiat conversion strategies.
  • High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual salary R$330,000–R$390,000.
  • Fully remote position within Brazil.
  • Direct responsibility for stablecoin-based treasury and payment infrastructure.
  • Exposure to international gaming payments and digital asset liquidity management.
  • Performance-oriented, data-driven working environment.
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational efficiency and capital optimization.

title: Stablecoin Payments Manager – Poker & Gaming
description:
EUROPROP® Trading is a performance-driven trading and digital asset firm operating at the intersection of quantitative finance, strategic gaming, and crypto-integrated treasury infrastructure. We specialize in disciplined capital allocation, stablecoin liquidity management, and cross-border digital payment systems designed for high-performance environments.


Our team combines expertise in crypto markets, treasury operations, gaming finance, and risk management to build secure, scalable payment frameworks. As we expand our poker and gaming payment infrastructure, we are seeking a highly skilled Stablecoin Payments Manager to lead and optimize stablecoin-based settlement and liquidity operations.


This is a high-impact role where operational precision, blockchain expertise, and capital efficiency directly influence performance outcomes.


Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee all stablecoin-based payment flows (USDT, USDC, and similar) across poker and gaming platforms.
  • Manage wallet infrastructure (hot/cold wallets) and ensure secure, efficient transaction processing.
  • Optimize liquidity allocation across platforms to minimize transfer costs and settlement delays.
  • Coordinate with exchanges, OTC desks, and payment providers for conversions and liquidity management.
  • Monitor blockchain transaction activity, fees, confirmation times, and operational risk exposure.
  • Implement AML/KYC and transaction monitoring controls for crypto payments.
  • Prepare treasury and payment performance reports, including liquidity ratios and cost efficiency metrics.


Requirements
  • Proven experience managing stablecoin or cryptocurrency payment operations.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain networks (e.g., TRC20, ERC20), wallet management, and exchange operations.
  • Experience handling high-volume crypto transactions in gaming, trading, or fintech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of liquidity management, volatility mitigation, and crypto-to-fiat conversion strategies.
  • High attention to detail and strong analytical skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual salary R$330,000–R$390,000.
  • Fully remote position within Brazil.
  • Direct responsibility for stablecoin-based treasury and payment infrastructure.
  • Exposure to international gaming payments and digital asset liquidity management.
  • Performance-oriented, data-driven working environment.
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational efficiency and capital optimization.

title: Arquiteto de soluções Azure
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.

O que Buscamos?

Arquiteto de soluções Azure (Banco de talentos)

Descrição:

  • Experiência mandatória com Projeto com IA utilizando Copilot e Microsoft Foundry
  • Design e Implantação de Arquitetura;
  • Especialista em .NET Framework/.NET Core;
  • Experiência com arquiteturas escaláveis utilizando serviços de nuvem como Azure (App Service, API Management, tecnologias serverless, orquestração de containers como Kubernetes, Cloud Foundry, frameworks de microsserviços, SDKs e etc);
  • Habilidade em apresentações técnicas e foco no cliente, confortável em diferentes públicos;
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas em implantação de aplicações e infraestrutura em ambientes locais e na nuvem;
  • Experiência em DevOps (Azure DevOps Services, Azure DevOps Server);
  • Experiência técnica em larga escala com infraestruturas em nuvem e híbridas, design de arquitetura, migrações e gestão de tecnologia;
  • Vivência e entendimento de portfólios de aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte, incluindo migração de workloads locais para a nuvem;
  • Experiência técnica em larga escala com hospedagem de aplicações nativas em nuvem, design, desenvolvimento, implantação e refatoração/migração de aplicações;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de servidores web, design de aplicações em nuvem, arquitetura de software e práticas como Agile, SCRUM e DevOps;
  • Práticas de desenvolvimento de software como DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD (Jenkins, Spinnaker, Azure DevOps, etc);
  • Certificações AZ-204, AZ-400;

Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens exporaticas)

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer (2 Openings)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)

We are hiring two Senior Designers to support a complex, enterprise-scale environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, navigates sophisticated stakeholder ecosystems, and drives design across overlapping product areas.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end product design (problem framing → user flows → interaction patterns → UI → validation)
  • Translate ambiguous or messy requirements into clear UX direction and prioritized scope
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working sessions to drive alignment and decision-making
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to plan increments and define trade-offs
  • Produce high-quality Figma deliverables (journeys, IA, wireframes, prototypes, specifications)
  • Coach and support mid-level designers when needed

Must-Have Requirements

  • Expert-level Figma execution (this is non-negotiable)
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
  • Experience working in large, complex, and robust enterprise environments
  • Background in regulated, technical, or high-compliance industries
  • Ability to operate across UX and visual design
  • Working knowledge of research methodologies

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in Healthcare or Financial Services
  • Analytics background
  • Experience with workshop tools (Miro, FigJam)
  • Service blueprinting experience

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.

Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.

Modelo de Contratação:

PJ

Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na oportunidade.
